## Current Code Workflow (from code analyzer)
# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The supplied code diagnoses a GRU4Rec model through `ModelView`; backbone internals are not shown. `log2feats(sequence)` returns per-position features shaped B × L × H. The probe extracts the final user state at the **maximum nonzero input position**, correctly handling left padding; empty histories produce zero states. `predict_score(features, items)` supplies actual model scores, including learned biases.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses `view.model`, `item_emb`, `user_train`, metadata interfaces, feature extraction and scoring. The training loader provides `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` tensors shaped B × L. Training histories supply frequency counts and temporal examples; unavailable item categories are never inferred.

`run_full_diagnosis` uses evaluation/inference mode and seed 42, then restores the original training mode and Python, NumPy and Torch RNG states.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings and maps mean pairwise cosine to [0,1]. Higher values indicate directional alignment, potentially collapse; this does not measure recommendation diversity.
- **Sampled separation:** Across at most ten loader batches, computes positive-minus-negative scores at nonpadding positions. Reports mean, lower tenth percentile, negative-wins rate and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower failure rates indicate stronger sampled training separation. Counts and positive-item frequency strata accompany results.
- **Execution checks:** Verify shapes, finite outputs, zero padding features, leading-padding invariance, batched/individual scoring agreement and parity with the module’s `score_candidates`. Failures disable temporal interpretation.

# Perturbation & Tests

For up to 200 eligible training users, select one training target preceded by at least five retained interactions. Freeze the target plus 99 unique negatives excluding the full training history.

Compare unchanged prefixes against oldest/recent/random deletions, local block shuffles, final-item removal and last-item-only inputs. Random deletion and shuffle each have five repeats. Measure target-rank change, HR@10 change, state cosine distance and normalized displacement. Positive rank change or negative HR change indicates damage; state movement alone establishes sensitivity.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

Returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`. Metrics include embedding and margin summaries, `execution_checks`, `temporal_sensitivity`, availability reasons and elapsed diagnostic time. Temporal output contains counts, exclusions, per-user outcomes, category summaries and length/repeat-target slices. Paired user bootstrap intervals require at least 30 complete users.

Four-category macro fields remain null because one view supplies one category. These are conditional, in-sample diagnostics—not validation gains or causal intent evidence. Null means unavailable. Official macro validation HR@10 alone selects models. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` embeds measurements and definitions into instructions for a concise JSON interpretation.
